purpose: Constructively screen every catalog delete-one/add-two fixed core with eight persistent C++ workers, without promoting unchecked UNSAT statuses.
amendment_reason: The first one-subprocess-per-pair attempt was intentionally terminated after 1738 records because operating-system process-launch throttling dominated its runtime. That partial directory is ABORTED_PARTIAL_NO_RESULT and will not be resumed or combined with this fresh run.
pair_selection: exact Cartesian product of catalog lines 1..328 and deletion labels 0..41

status_policy.SAT: Atomically preserve the raw model before reconstruction, then require both independent graph verifiers. Only dual-verified SAT is certified.
status_policy.UNSAT: Record OBSERVED_UNSAT_UNCHECKED with solver statistics. This is a reproducible computational observation, never a certified negative.
status_policy.LIMIT: Record LIMIT_NO_CONCLUSION exactly; do not infer SAT or UNSAT.
status_policy.ERROR: Record SCREEN_ERROR exactly and fail the coverage/status audit.

coverage_policy: Require every pair in the Cartesian product and no extra pair.
Require every persisted record artifact to hash-match its summary record.
Require each record's selected line and deletion to agree with the solver output.
Require catalog, solver binary, producer source, runner, and coverage-checker hashes to match this plan.
Require zero worker errors, exact aggregate status counts, and negative_certified_count=0.
sat_artifact_policy: Write the raw zero-based true-variable model atomically before any graph processing.
Write graph6 and canonical JSON for the reconstructed 43-vertex graph.
Run the exhaustive Python five-subset verifier.
Run the independent C++ recursive bitset clique verifier on graph and complement.
Retain every model and verifier output even if verification fails.
scope_warning: Even 13776 observed UNSAT statuses would only be an unchecked screen of these fixed 41-vertex cores. They would not certify their nonextendibility and would not imply global order-43 nonexistence. The earlier 16-pair checked pilot remains the only certified negative subset.
